# peritissimus

> The portfolio of Kushal Patankar, a founding engineer and systems architect building scalable AI products and infrastructure.

This site contains information about Kushal's professional work, independent software projects, technical writing, and ways to get in touch.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://peritissimus.com/): Overview, selected work, and latest writing.
- [About](https://peritissimus.com/about): Background, experience, and technical focus.
- [Software](https://peritissimus.com/software): Independent software projects and experiments.
- [Work](https://peritissimus.com/work/zoca): Selected professional case studies.
- [Blog](https://peritissimus.com/blog): Technical articles about AI products and infrastructure.
- [Contact](https://peritissimus.com/contact): Ways to contact Kushal.

## Featured writing

- [Scaling LLM Applications in Production](https://peritissimus.com/blog/scaling-llm-applications): Lessons from building and scaling AI-powered platforms.
- [Processing 2,000 Hours of Media a Day with Celery and Redis](https://peritissimus.com/blog/celery-redis-media-pipeline): Queue design for a video dubbing pipeline.

## Stone

Stone is a free, open-source, local-first note-taking app for Mac. Notes, journals, tasks, and meeting transcripts are plain Markdown files on your own disk.

- [Stone project page](https://peritissimus.com/work/stone): What Stone is and how it is built.
- [Stone: A Local-First Markdown Note-Taking App for Mac](https://peritissimus.com/blog/stone-local-first-note-taking-app): Features, who it is for, and how to install it.
- [Local Meeting Transcription on a Mac with whisper.cpp](https://peritissimus.com/blog/local-meeting-transcription-whisper-cpp): On-device meeting transcription with echo cancellation.
- [Markdown Files as the Source of Truth, SQLite as an Index You Can Delete](https://peritissimus.com/blog/markdown-notes-sqlite-search-index): Hybrid search and related notes over plain files.
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/peritissimus/stone-electron)
